title: CE60101: Design Of Prestressed Concrete Structures
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Early developments, advantages and applications, methods of achieving prestress
and materials. Classification in types 1,2 and 3. Mechanics of prestressed
concrete design: Magnel's inequalities, kern distances, choice of sections for
flexural members, tendon profiles in post tensioned and pre tensioned members,
reversal of moments. Limit state design for flexure and shear. Losses in
prestress, deflections. Prestress-cast-in-situ composites. Indeterminate
structures: continuous beams and portals, secondary moments, concordant and
transformed tendon profiles. Anchorage zone stresses; Design of prestressed
concrete bridges; Review of IS code.
